Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:144187
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11062 of 2023

Applicant :- Raju Sharma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Om Narayan Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ram Narayan Srivastava, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
44 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Shahjahanpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the deceased was performed with the applicant on 24.6.2019 and after marriage, applicant and his family members tortured the deceased for want of dowry and for want of dowry, they have committed her murder on 21.1.2020.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and only being husband of the deceased he has been made accused in the present matter.

He further submitted that actually deceased was not happy with her marriage Raju Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194307155/
1 with the applicant and therefore, within seven years of her marriage, she committed suicide by ablazing herself.
5.

entities.text: Raju Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 23.1.2020 i.e. for more than three and a half years and till date, trial of the case could not been even concluded.
6. He further submitted that in the charge sheet there are as many as 23 prosecution witnesses and out of them till date, only two prosecution witnesses could be examined.
He further submitted that therefore, it appears that trial is moving with languid pace.
7. He next submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and therefore, he may be released on bail.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within seven months of her marriage due to burn injury and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and applicant in the entire bail application failed to explain the death of his wife and even he did not claim in the bail application that deceased committed suicide due to the reason that she was not happy with her marriage with the applicant and in the absence of the specific plea, argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant in the Court today should not be accepted.
9.
He further submitted that as applicant is husband of the deceased, therefore, he does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Although, applicant appears to be in jail in the present matter since 23.1.2020 i.e. for last three and a half years but he is the husband of the deceased and his wife died within seven years of marriage due to burn injuries and there are also allegation of demand of dowry.

12. Further, although learned counsel for the applicant argued that as deceased was not happy with her marriage, therefore, she committed suicide by ablazing herself but no such defence was taken by the applicant in the instant bail application, therefore, it appears that applicant failed to explain the abnormal death of his wife.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, the instant bail application stands rejected.

15. However, considering the fact that applicant is in jail for last three and a half years, trial court is directed to conclude the trial within one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order, strictly as per the provision of section 309 Cr.P.C., if there is no legal impediment.
